notes.title: ENIGMA has UPDATED! for ver 16.8.4 !!!
notes.content:
ENIGMA has UPDATED! for ver 16.8.4 !!!

Fixed some trouble.

Maybe can use cloud save data. (I'm not sure)

plz ~ 
1.backup your all save file looks like 'Save01.rvdata2' from local contents folder. 
2.delete local contents ENIGMA on steam client. 
3.reinstall ENIGMA. 
4.then you can see changed version at title bar to 16.8.4 
5.paste your save file to local contents folder. 
6.enjoy Enigma with less bug.
